testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a custom annotation scale: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1060:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a custom annotation scale ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and activates BrowserView ✔ And an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto ✔ When the user opens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ And the user chooses Custom ✔ Then the Edit Annotation Scale dialog opens with Auto selected ✔ And OK is disabled ✔ When the user replaces the scale with "3:2" ✔ Then the scale field displays "3:2" ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ And the user reopens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then Auto is checked ✔ When the user dismisses the menus ✔ Then the copied view remains active
